# two-context-bands

The scanned item has both a standalone asking-price group (the part on its own) and an in_pc group
(the same catalogue item counted inside built PCs). scan-lookup never guesses which condition the
scanned item is in, so it shows every qualifying band rather than picking one (no invented
number). Both qualify (n>=10) and both come back, still one `facebook` source and one credit
charged for the one scan.
